categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the power semiconductor sector, focusing on the design, research, production, and sales of IGBT, FRD power semiconductor chips, discrete devices, and modules. Its products serve industries including industrial control, new energy vehicles, new energy power generation, energy storage, and consumer electronics. The company also provides power semiconductor device solutions and system integration services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced trench gate and field-stop structures, virtual cell technology, reverse conduction IGBT, micro-trench IGBT, soft recovery diode chips, high-efficiency rectifier diode chips, high-voltage MOS chip technology, silver sintering technology for module packaging, low parasitic parameter module wiring, ultrasonic bonding for terminals, and planar transfer molding for dual/single-sided water cooling. The company employs fabless chip design with outsourced wafer manufacturing and in-house module packaging and testing, emphasizing R&D and innovation in Si, SiC, and GaN semiconductor materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in industrial control, new energy vehicles, new energy power generation (such as photovoltaic inverters and wind power converters), energy storage, and home appliances. The company has strategic partnerships with major industrial giants like Hitachi Energy, Siemens, Eaton, and top domestic new energy vehicle manufacturers. Its products are used in electric vehicle motor controllers, charging piles, industrial robots, and smart home appliances.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province. It is expanding its market presence globally, supplying products and services to international industrial leaders and participating in global supply chains. Domestic market penetration is strong, especially in the automotive and industrial sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power semiconductor supply chain. It focuses on chip design (fabless model), module packaging, testing, and system integration, outsourcing wafer fabrication to foundries. It also manages procurement of raw materials and components, and sells finished semiconductor devices and modules to end customers and OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing third-generation semiconductor technologies (SiC, GaN), enhancing IGBT and MOSFET performance, expanding product lines for automotive, photovoltaic, energy storage, and industrial applications, and digital transformation of production. R&D efforts focus on high-voltage, high-current, and high-reliability power devices, module packaging innovations, and new materials. The company invests heavily in R&D (8.24% of revenue) and maintains a strong patent portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of power semiconductor chips, discrete devices, and modules. The company also earns income from technical service fees during product development and customization phases. Sales channels include direct sales and distribution partnerships, with a focus on long-term supply contracts and strategic customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China's power semiconductor market, competing with international giants such as Infineon, Mitsubishi Electric, Fuji Electric, ON Semiconductor, and STMicroelectronics. It has achieved breakthroughs in mid-to-high-end markets and is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative enterprise. The company is actively pursuing market share expansion and technological catch-up in third-generation semiconductors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.33 billion, a decrease of 11.52% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 14.47 million. Despite short-term pressures, the company showed resilience with a 9.13% revenue growth in the second half of 2024. R&D investment increased to RMB 109.76 million, accounting for 8.24% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 2.6 billion with a 58.58% asset-liability ratio. The company is focused on high-quality growth and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological innovation and product performance leadership, particularly in SiC MOSFET and IGBT modules that meet automotive-grade reliability standards. Its unique value lies in a comprehensive product portfolio covering chips to modules, advanced packaging technologies like silver sintering and dual-sided water cooling, and customized solutions for strategic customers. The company also highlights its commitment to green, energy-efficient products aligned with national carbon neutrality goals, and its robust R&D capabilities and intellectual property portfolio.
